name: Afraid
overview: Scripture reveals that fear is overcome by trusting in the presence and power of the LORD, who is our refuge and strength. Believers are commanded to be strong and courageous, knowing that God will never fail or forsake them, as seen in Deuteronomy 31:6 and Joshua 1:9. The Psalms affirm that the LORD is our light and salvation, delivering us from fear when we seek Him (Psalms 27:1, 34:4), and that those who dwell in His presence find protection under His shadow (Psalms 46:1, 91:1). This confidence in God’s steadfast care enables believers to face trials without fear.
